class=\"desk-title\">Banche Centrali · Decisioni e mercato<\/h1><p class=\"desk-copy\">Per ogni banca: tasso ufficiale, ultima decisione, prossimo meeting e ciò che OIS/futures incorporano oggi. <strong>Il repricing non è una probabilità di taglio.<\/strong><\/p><div class=\"desk-mode\">● Dati con fonte e data · ufficiali e stime separati<\/div><\/div><\/div>\n<div aria-live=\"polite\" id=\"cb-chart\"><div class=\"withheld\">Caricamento OIS / Futures…<\/div><\/div><p class=\"desk-caption\" id=\"cb-chart-caption\">OIS ufficiale e future stimato sono fonti differenti: non confonderli. Il differenziale non è un segnale FX isolato.<\/p><\/div><\/article>\n<article class=\"desk-panel\"><h2 class=\"desk-panel-title\">Come leggere queste informazioni<\/h2><div class=\"desk-panel-body\"><p class=\"desk-text\"><strong>1. Policy osservata:<\/strong> dove si trova oggi la banca centrale e quale decisione ha preso.<\/p><p class=\"desk-text\"><strong>2. Prezzi di mercato:<\/strong> quanto cambia il tasso atteso a 3, 6 e 12 mesi rispetto alla policy.<\/p><p class=\"desk-text\"><strong>3. Conferme:<\/strong> cosa succede al 2Y e al cambio dopo un nuovo dato. Se divergono, la tesi resta da verificare.<\/p><div class=\"desk-note\">Le date delle decisioni non attestano da sole che l'intera narrativa sia aggiornata. Repricing datato o non certificato → indicazione sospesa.<\/div><p class=\"desk-statusline\" id=\"cb-status\" role=\"status\">Validazione feed…<\/p><\/div><\/article><\/div>\n<div class=\"desk-panel\"><h2 class=\"desk-panel-title\">Policy book · G8 <span class=\"desk-meta\">Clicca una banca per approfondire<\/span><\/h2><div class=\"desk-table-wrap\"><table class=\"desk-table cb-table\"><thead><tr><th>Banca<\/th><th>Tasso policy<\/th><th>Stance snapshot<\/th><th>Ultima decisione<\/th><th>Prossimo meeting<\/th><th>6M vs policy<\/th><th>Fonte pricing<\/th><\/tr><\/thead><tbody id=\"cb-table\"><tr><td colspan=\"7\">Caricamento…<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/div><div class=\"desk-source\">Dati policy: NATIVE_CB_DATA (snapshot, data dell'ultima decisione). Pricing: OIS_OPERATIONAL_VIEW (fonte e as-of propri per valuta). Nessuna probabilità di decisione inferita da questi tassi.<\/div><\/div>\n<div aria-live=\"polite\" class=\"desk-panel cb-detail\" id=\"cb-detail\"><h2 class=\"desk-panel-title\">Focus banca centrale <span class=\"desk-meta\">Seleziona una valuta<\/span><\/h2><div class=\"desk-panel-body\"><p class=\"desk-text\">Seleziona una banca nella tabella per visualizzare decisione, contesto e curva di mercato.<\/p><\/div><\/div>\n<div class=\"desk-preview-footer\">GLOBAL MACRO FX QUANT · Design v9 · Research preview · Non pubblicato sul sito principale<\/div><\/main><\/div><script>/* GLOBAL MACRO FX QUANT v5 | Shared verified-data adapter. Display-only; never creates trading signals. */\n(()=>{'use strict';\nconst URL='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/robybizkit77-blip/global-macro-fx-quant/main/live_data/sections/';\nconst FILES={fx:'ECB_G8_PRICE_HISTORY.json',rates:'NATIVE_RATES_DATA.json',ois:'OIS_OPERATIONAL_VIEW.json',setup:'PAIR_SETUP_OPERATIONAL_VIEW.json'};\nconst CCYS=['USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','AUD','CAD','NZD','CHF'];\nconst FLAGS={USD:'🇺🇸',EUR:'🇪🇺',GBP:'🇬🇧',JPY:'🇯🇵',AUD:'🇦🇺',CAD:'🇨🇦',NZD:'🇳🇿',CHF:'🇨🇭'};\nconst LABEL={USD:'US',EUR:'DE',GBP:'UK',JPY:'JP',AUD:'AU',CAD:'CA',NZD:'NZ',CHF:'CH'};\nconst CB={USD:'Fed',EUR:'ECB',GBP:'BoE',JPY:'BoJ',AUD:'RBA',CAD:'BoC',NZD:'RBNZ',CHF:'SNB'};\nconst num=v=>(typeof v==='number'&&Number.isFinite(v)?v:null);\nconst safe=v=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>\"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\"':'&quot;','\\'':'&#39;'}[c]));\nconst fmt=(v,d=2)=>num(v)===null?'—':v.toFixed(d);\nconst signed=(v,d=2,sfx='')=>num(v)===null?'—':`${v>0?'+':''}${v.toFixed(d)}${sfx}`;\nconst today=()=>{const x=new Date();return Date.UTC(x.getUTCFullYear(),x.getUTCMonth(),x.getUTCDate())};\nconst age=s=>{if(!/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/.test((s||'').slice(0,10)))return Infinity;return Math.floor((today()-Date.parse(s.slice(0,10)+'T00:00:00Z'))/86400000)};\nconst fresh=(d,days=4)=>age(d)>=0&&age(d)<=days;\nconst flag=k=>FLAGS[k]||'🌐';\nfunction fxRows(data){if(data?.status!=='CURRENT_OFFICIAL_HISTORY'||!Array.isArray(data.rows))return[];return data.rows.filter(x=>/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/.test(x?.Date||'')&&x.Date<=data.last_as_of&&num(x.USD)!==null).sort((a,b)=>a.Date.localeCompare(b.Date))}\nfunction quote(x,c){if(!x||!num(x.USD))return null;const v=c==='EUR'?1:num(x[c]);return v&&v>0?({'EUR':()=>x.USD,'JPY':()=>x.JPY/x.USD,'CAD':()=>x.CAD/x.USD,'CHF':()=>x.CHF/x.USD}[c]?.()??x.USD/v):null}\nfunction pairName(c){return ({USD:'USD',EUR:'EUR/USD',GBP:'GBP/USD',JPY:'USD/JPY',AUD:'AUD/USD',CAD:'USD/CAD',NZD:'NZD/USD',CHF:'USD/CHF'})[c]||c}\nfunction strength(a,b,c){if(c==='USD')return 0;const v1=quote(a,c),v2=quote(b,c);if(!v1||!v2)return null;return ['JPY','CAD','CHF'].includes(c)?100*(v1/v2-1):100*(v2/v1-1)}\nfunction historical(x,which,asof){const h=x?.[which];if(!h)return[];let rows=Array.isArray(h)?h.map(i=>({date:i.date,value:num(i.value)})):Array.isArray(h.dates)?h.dates.map((date,i)=>({date,value:num(h.values?.[i])})):[];return rows.filter(p=>p.date&&p.date<=asof&&num(p.value)!==null).sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date))}\nfunction validRates(x){const asof=x?.date;if(!fresh(asof,4)||!String(x?.quality||'').includes('OFFICIAL'))return null;const y2=num(x['2Y']),y10=num(x['10Y']);if(y2===null)return null;return {date:asof,y2,y10,history2:historical(x,'history2',asof),history10:historical(x,'history10',asof)}}\nfunction pricing(x){if(!x||!fresh(x.as_of,4)||x.operational_status==='WITHHELD')return null;\n const official=x.quality==='OFFICIAL_CERTIFIED'&&x.official_status==='ACTIVE';const estimated=x.quality==='ESTIMATED_INFORMATIONAL'&&x.operational_status==='GREEN_ESTIMATED';if(!official&&!estimated)return null;\n return {date:x.as_of,type:official?'OFFICIAL':'STIMA',source:x.source,values:Object.fromEntries(['3m','6m','12m'].map(h=>[h,num(x?.horizons?.[h]?.policy_delta_bp)]))}}\nfunction sourceStatus(j){return j?{ok:true}:{ok:false}}\nasync function getJSON(key){const file=FILES[key];if(!file)throw new Error('Unknown source');const ctrl=new AbortController();const timeout=setTimeout(()=>ctrl.abort(),12000);try{const res=await fetch(URL+file,{cache:'no-store',signal:ctrl.signal});if(!res.ok)throw new Error('Feed HTTP '+res.status);return await res.json()}finally{clearTimeout(timeout)}}\nasync function load(...keys){return Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(keys.map(async k=>{try{return[k,await getJSON(k)]}catch(e){console.warn('[GMFQ v5 data withheld]',k,e);return [k,null]}})))}\nfunction barChart(rows,{title='Grafico a barre',suffix='%',zero=true}={}){const W=820,H=270,L=50,R=24,T=20,B=44,inner=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B;\n const usable=rows.filter(r=>num(r.value)!==null),mn=zero?Math.min(0,...usable.map(x=>x.value)):Math.min(...usable.map(x=>x.value),0),mx=zero?Math.max(0,...usable.map(x=>x.value)):Math.max(...usable.map(x=>x.value),1),limit=Math.max(Math.abs(mn),Math.abs(mx),.05)*1.15;\n const lo=zero?-limit:mn,hi=zero?limit:mx,y=v=>T+ph*(hi-v)/(hi-lo||1),base=y(0),step=inner/Math.max(rows.length,1),bw=Math.min(43,step*.5);\n let svg='';for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){let v=hi-(hi-lo)*i/4,Y=y(v);svg+=`<line x1=\"${L}\" x2=\"${W-R}\" y1=\"${Y}\" y2=\"${Y}\" stroke=\"${Math.abs(v)<.0001?'#5c7080':'#203a4b'}\" stroke-width=\".85\"/><text x=\"${L-9}\" y=\"${Y+3}\" text-anchor=\"end\" fill=\"#96b0c4\" font-size=\"12\">${v.toFixed(1)}${suffix}<\/text>`}\n rows.forEach((row,i)=>{let v=num(row.value),cx=L+step*(i+.5),X=cx-bw/2;const c=v===null?'#576a7b':v>=0?'#3dd398':'#f14960';if(v!==null){let Y=y(v);svg+=`<rect x=\"${X}\" y=\"${Math.min(Y,base)}\" width=\"${bw}\" height=\"${Math.max(1,Math.abs(Y-base))}\" rx=\"2\" fill=\"${c}\"/><text x=\"${cx}\" y=\"${v>=0?Y-8:Y+17}\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-size=\"12\" fill=\"#e8f0f7\">${signed(v,2,suffix)}<\/text>`}svg+=`<text x=\"${cx}\" y=\"${H-15}\" text-anchor=\"middle\" fill=\"#cedfed\" font-size=\"13\">${safe(row.label)}<\/text>`});return `<svg role=\"img\" aria-label=\"${safe(title)}\" viewBox=\"0 0 ${W} ${H}\" preserveAspectRatio=\"xMidYMid meet\">${svg}<\/svg>`}\nfunction lineChart(series,{title='Storico',unit='%',xMinDate='',xMaxDate=''}={}){const W=820,H=270,L=48,R=26,T=22,B=40,w=W-L-R,h=H-T-B,pts=series.flatMap(s=>s.data||[]);if(pts.length<4)return'<div class=\"withheld\">Storico insufficiente · grafico sospeso<\/div>';const all=pts.map(p=>p.value),mn=Math.min(...all),mx=Math.max(...all),pad=Math.max(.16,(mx-mn)*.12),low=mn-pad,hi=mx+pad;const xx=(date)=>{let a=Date.parse(xMinDate+'T00:00:00Z'),b=Date.parse(xMaxDate+'T00:00:00Z'),d=Date.parse(date+'T00:00:00Z');return L+w*(d-a)/(b-a||1)},yy=v=>T+h*(hi-v)/(hi-low||1);let o='';for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){let Y=T+i*h/4,value=hi-(hi-low)*i/4;o+=`<line x1=\"${L}\" x2=\"${W-R}\" y1=\"${Y}\" y2=\"${Y}\" stroke=\"#203a4b\" stroke-width=\".85\"/><text x=\"${L-9}\" y=\"${Y+4}\" fill=\"#9cb6c9\" font-size=\"12\" text-anchor=\"end\">${value.toFixed(2)}${unit}<\/text>`}\n series.forEach(s=>{let items=(s.data||[]).filter(p=>p.date>=xMinDate&&p.date<=xMaxDate);if(items.length<2)return;o+=`<polyline fill=\"none\" stroke=\"${s.color}\" stroke-width=\"2.1\" points=\"${items.map(p=>`${xx(p.date).toFixed(1)},${yy(p.value).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ')}\"/>`});o+=`<text x=\"${L}\" y=\"${H-12}\" fill=\"#a5bfce\" font-size=\"12\">${safe(xMinDate)}<\/text><text x=\"${W-R}\" y=\"${H-12}\" text-anchor=\"end\" fill=\"#a5bfce\" font-size=\"12\">${safe(xMaxDate)}<\/text>`;return `<svg role=\"img\" aria-label=\"${safe(title)}\" viewBox=\"0 0 ${W} ${H}\" preserveAspectRatio=\"xMidYMid meet\">${o}<\/svg>`}\nwindow.GMFQ={FILES,CCYS,FLAGS,LABEL,CB,num,fmt,signed,fresh,age,flag,safe,fxRows,quote,pairName,strength,historical,validRates,pricing,load,barChart,lineChart};\n})();\n<\/script><script>/* v6 | Banche Centrali: official-policy snapshot + independently dated OIS/futures. */\n(()=>{'use strict';\nconst G=window.GMFQ,CCYS=G.CCYS,FLAGS=G.FLAGS,CB=G.CB;\nconst ROOT='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/robybizkit77-blip/global-macro-fx-quant/main/live_data/sections/';\nconst el=id=>document.getElementById(id), esc=G.safe,fmt=G.fmt,signed=G.signed;\nlet state={cb:null,ois:null,selected:'USD'};\nconst officialPricing=x=>x?.type==='OFFICIAL';\nconst qualityLabel=p=>p?`<span class=\"desk-quality ${officialPricing(p)?'official':'estimated'}\">${officialPricing(p)?'UFFICIALE':'STIMA SECONDARIA'}<\/span>`:'<span class=\"desk-quality withheld\">WITHHELD<\/span>';\nconst statusClass=s=>{const v=String(s||'').toUpperCase();return v.startsWith('HAWK')?'hawk':v.startsWith('DOV')?'dove':'neutral'};\nconst dateOrDash=s=>/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/.test(s||'')?s:'—';\nconst contextHint=(p)=>{if(!p||G.num(p.values['6m'])===null)return 'Repricing non disponibile.';const d=p.values['6m'];return Math.abs(d)<5?'Il repricing a sei mesi è molto vicino al tasso policy (non è un segnale d’ingresso).':d>0?'Il percorso a sei mesi incorpora tassi più alti della policy attuale. Verifica se il 2Y e il cambio confermano.':'Il percorso a sei mesi incorpora tassi più bassi della policy attuale. Serve conferma nel 2Y e nel cambio.';};\nasync function loadOne(name){const ctrl=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>ctrl.abort(),12000);try{const r=await fetch(ROOT+name,{cache:'no-store',signal:ctrl.signal});if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return await r.json()}finally{clearTimeout(timer)}}\nfunction plot(rows){const items=rows.filter(x=>G.num(x.value)!==null),W=820,H=275,L=54,R=16,T=27,B=47,X=W-L-R,Y=H-T-B;\nif(!items.length)return '<div class=\"withheld\">Nessun repricing validato disponibile<\/div>';\nconst bound=Math.max(20,...items.map(x=>Math.abs(x.value)))*1.18;const y=v=>T+Y*(bound-v)/(2*bound),z=y(0),unit=X/CCYS.length,bw=Math.min(48,unit*.55);let html='';\n[-bound,-bound/2,0,bound/2,bound].reverse().forEach(v=>{const yy=y(v);html+=`<line x1=\"${L}\" x2=\"${W-R}\" y1=\"${yy}\" y2=\"${yy}\" stroke=\"${v===0?'#6a8192':'#20394d'}\" stroke-width=\".9\"/><text x=\"${L-8}\" y=\"${yy+4}\" text-anchor=\"end\" font-size=\"12\" fill=\"#a7bfce\">${Math.round(v)}<\/text>`});\nCCYS.forEach((k,i)=>{const d=rows.find(x=>x.k===k),cx=L+unit*(i+.5);if(d&&G.num(d.value)!==null){const yy=y(d.value),color=d.p?.type==='OFFICIAL'?'#3bd2a0':'#448fe9';html+=`<rect x=\"${cx-bw/2}\" y=\"${Math.min(yy,z)}\" width=\"${bw}\" height=\"${Math.max(1,Math.abs(yy-z))}\" rx=\"2\" fill=\"${color}\"/><text x=\"${cx}\" y=\"${d.value>=0?yy-8:yy+15}\" font-size=\"12\" text-anchor=\"middle\" fill=\"#dfedf5\">${signed(d.value,0,'')}<\/text>`}html+=`<text x=\"${cx}\" y=\"${H-24}\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-size=\"14\">${FLAGS[k]}<\/text><text x=\"${cx}\" y=\"${H-7}\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-size=\"11\" fill=\"#b7cadb\">${k}<\/text>`});\nconst mobile=CCYS.map(k=>{const d=rows.find(x=>x.k===k),v=d?.value,p=d?.p;return `<div class=\"mini-metric-row\"><span>${FLAGS[k]} ${k}<\/span><b class=\"${G.num(v)===null?'':'desk-ok'}\">${G.num(v)===null?'WITHHELD':signed(v,1,' pb')}<\/b><small>${p?p.type==='OFFICIAL'?'UFFICIALE':'STIMA':'SOSPESO'}<\/small><\/div>`}).join('');return `<svg class=\"desktop-chart\" viewBox=\"0 0 ${W} ${H}\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Repricing a
